positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified
positions.frame: what is the current verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph?
positions.why: src-1 states the calibration event and its verification against the June reference plates in narrative prose; src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument identity and calibration/verification facts as flat labelled fields. All three converge on one directional read — a settled, unhedged claim that 88.4 MHz calibration holds, checked against a named reference standard — carried in the same calm-positive, matter-of-fact, expert/competence register whether narrated or field-tagged. No tension: the field entries are a compressed restatement of the narrative claim, not a distinct or competing read.
